items.question: What happens to a file with no Feature: line, or with content before it?
items.ticket: Invalid files report the line of the error
items.chose: Throws a ParseError at the first non-comment line for content before Feature:. For a file with no Feature: line at all, it throws at line 1.
items.instead: Return an empty feature, or report the last line of the file.

items.question: Is a feature with no scenarios valid?
items.ticket: Valid files return scenarios in order
items.chose: Returns the feature with an empty scenarios list and no error.
items.instead: Throw an error because the feature has no scenarios.

items.question: Are Scenario Outline and Rule supported?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError at the line saying the construct is not supported.
items.instead: Parse Scenario Outline as a scenario or ignore it, and accept Rule: as a grouping.

items.question: Is "Example:" accepted as a scenario keyword, and what about a Scenario line with no colon or an empty name?
items.chose: Accepts "Scenario:" and "Example:" with a trimmed name that may be empty.
items.instead: Accept only "Scenario:", and reject an empty name.

items.question: How are Background steps represented, and what does an empty Background give?
items.chose: Sets background to null when there is none. An empty Background gives an empty list. A second Background, or one after a scenario, is an error.
items.instead: Merge Background steps into every scenario, or treat an empty Background as an error.

items.question: What happens to free-text lines that are not steps?
items.chose: Ignores them between Feature: and the first Background or Scenario. Elsewhere, an unrecognised line is a ParseError.
items.instead: Ignore prose everywhere, such as scenario descriptions, or reject it everywhere.

items.question: Are steps allowed before any Scenario or Background?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError at the step's line.
items.instead: Ignore the steps, or attach them to an implicit scenario.

items.question: How are tags handled when they are not followed by a Scenario?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError at the line of the first tag line of the pending group. Tags on the Feature: line are discarded.
items.instead: Ignore dangling tags, or keep tags on the Feature.

items.question: What counts as a valid step keyword, and what happens when a step line has no text?
items.chose: Accepts Given, When, Then, And, But and * only when followed by whitespace, so "Andrew…" is not a step. It does not require any step text.
items.instead: Accept keywords case-insensitively or localised, and require non-empty step text.

items.question: How are doc strings delimited, indented and closed?
items.chose: Accepts """ or ``` delimiters, closed only by the same delimiter. It strips up to the opening line's indentation from each line and keeps the body as an array of lines. A missing close is an error at the opening line. A step can have only one doc string, and not both a doc string and a table.
items.instead: Accept only """, keep the content as one string, and leave the indentation untouched.

items.question: How are table rows parsed and attached to steps?
items.chose: Splits cells on unescaped pipes and trims them. It handles the escapes \|, \\ and \n. Rows attach to the previous step, and a row with no preceding step is an error. Rows do not have to be the same width.
items.instead: Leave cells untrimmed, skip escape handling, or require equal column counts.

items.question: How are line endings, a BOM and comments handled?
items.chose: Strips a leading BOM and a trailing \r. Skips blank lines and lines starting with #, so line numbers stay physical.
items.instead: Reject CRLF or a BOM, or treat # lines as errors.
